# Audience: external / other-districts

| Knob | Setting |
|---|---|
| **Tone** | Practical, candid, collegial. "Here's exactly how we did it." |
| **Reading level / jargon** | Ed-tech jargon fine; explain anything Orono-specific. |
| **Default theme** | Mode 1 (official). **Dark or light** both fine. |
| **Density** | Medium — they want enough detail to replicate. |
| **Formality** | Semi-formal, peer-to-peer. |
| **`data-motion`** | `standard`. |
| **QR / poll / badge** | QR welcome (templates, repos, the recipe). Polls optional. |
| **Preferred close** | "You can do this too" + the resources to start. |

## What to assume / emphasize
Emphasize **replicability** — steps, tools, gotchas, and what it took. Assume a
peer district with similar constraints who wants to copy the approach, not just
admire it. Be honest about what was hard.
